plainTranslation: Someone's Juno - the commitment marker - on your Sun, Moon, or Venus reads as marriage-flavored: settled, familiar, this could become serious. A useful signal of partnership potential. Still a beginning, not a verdict.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry feature notes. Source file was not copied into the repository.
